full_judgment: 10. The High Court Division, in the premises, acted no illegality in making the rule absolute. Whether or not fraud has been perpetrated by the respondent in obtaining decree is a disputed question of fact and this issue cannot be decided in a summary proceeding. The decisions referred to by Mr. Moudud Ahmed in National Engineers Limited V. Jubak Housing and Real Estate Development Limited, 67 DLR(AD)176; Master Abdul, Aziz V. Abani Mohan Mukherjee, 30 DLR(SC)221; MIS Hajee Mohammad Ali & Sons V. Burma Eastern Ltd.; 38 DLR(AD) 41, Jahanara Begum V. Md. Aminul Islam Chowdhury; 2 MLR(AD)216, Deputy Commissioner V. Md. Aswab Ali; 53 DLR(AD)186, Md. Nurul Huq @ M.N.Huq V. Nirmal Chandra Dutta; 7ADC 87, S.P. Chengalvaraya Naidu V. Jagannath(dead), 1994(1SCC)1 have no manner of application in the facts of the given case. We do not dispute the statements of law expressed in those cases but the applicability of the opinions expressed therein depends upon the facts in a given case. So we are not inclined to examine the decisions in support of the cases.
